requirements.title: Scenario-local orchestrator replaces scripts/scenarios/testing
requirements.description: Implement structure, dependency, unit, integration, and performance runners directly inside the scenario, exposing CLI + API triggers.

validation.notes: Covers scenario-local Go orchestrator execution, presets, fail-fast, and per-phase queuing
Validates .vrooli/testing.json ingestion, phase toggles, preset overrides, and timeout enforcement
Covers descriptor-backed suite planning and execution without legacy scripts

requirements.title: Terminal run reads share one versioned durable snapshot
requirements.description: Every terminal run persists one versioned canonical snapshot containing the complete phase results and terminal metadata; wait, show, history, comparison, and downstream consumers project that same record before and after in-memory retirement or service restart. Unrecoverable legacy fields are explicitly degraded rather than zero-filled.

validation.notes: Asserts terminal wait/show parity and canonical snapshot metadata on the immediate terminal read.
Asserts full phase hydration after service reconstruction over the same artifact directory.
Distinguishes pre-snapshot legacy runs from corrupt and unsupported snapshot versions.
Asserts wait and show JSON agree on run identity, phase set, per-phase status, and duration.

requirements.title: Runs preserve their effective descriptor catalog
requirements.description: A run captures the effective descriptor catalog and applicability decisions at execution start, using immutable phase machine keys and descriptor-owned presentation metadata so historical rendering and comparison do not depend on the live catalog.

validation.notes: Asserts planning freezes labels, provider, ordering, policy metadata, applicability decisions, and a content digest independently for each run.
Asserts atomic run-scoped persistence, round-trip fidelity, and tamper-detecting digest validation.
Exercises add, retire, reorder, display rename, provider change, applicability change, and provider-unavailable typed comparison reasons from captured catalogs.

requirements.title: Run evidence is typed, phase-agnostic, and safely addressable
requirements.description: Each run owns a versioned artifact catalog whose entries have opaque run-scoped ids, stable kinds, media metadata, producer phase metadata, and an unknown-kind fallback; consumers filter by evidence kind without receiving provider filesystem paths.

validation.notes: Covers atomic catalog round-trip, typed screenshot/video/result/log discovery, large metadata, descriptor-owned producer attribution, and path-free opaque ids.
Covers cross-run opaque id reuse, missing bytes, escaping symlinks, and duplicate id rejection.
Covers kind-filtered list/detail projection with no filesystem locator, advisory visual semantics, and safe access paths.
Covers opaque byte streaming, content typing, no-sniff behavior, and sandboxing of active HTML evidence.
Asserts an aborted or early-terminal run still receives a non-legacy persisted artifact catalog before terminal snapshot publication.
Guards truthful evidence-kind declarations for ui-health, workflow-health, performance-health, unit-health, and tidiness-manager.
